bio:
Art is subjective. Genre is just a suggestion. Creativity is life.

Welcome to the creative world of S.R. Chappell, where art, poetry, and music collide. Based in Atlanta, Georgia, Rachele Chappell is a multidisciplinary artist, poet, lyricist, and storyteller whose work explores beauty, rebellion, nostalgia, humor, heartbreak, and the wonderfully unexpected. Whether through evocative imagery, thought-provoking verse, or songs that refuse to stay in one lane, every creation is an invitation to see the world from a different angle.

This channel is home to original music, visual art, poetry, creative projects, and the occasional delightful detour into the surreal.

All music created by S.R. Chappell. Released via Velvet Static Records c/o Dream Skull Productions.

bio:
From the New Orleans (504) area code comes BennyJ504, a confident voice specializing in Pop-Rap and Trap that’s built for the lifestyle. With a flow that is both groovy and bold, his music fuses slick R&B melodies with the swagger of contemporary Hip-Hop.

Known for tracks like "The Louvre Job" and a sound reminiscent of high-energy artists like G-Eazy and the unpolished confidence of Cal Scruby, BennyJ504 crafts music that’s serious about its craft and ready for the main stage

name: Preshzino Songz
bio:
Amamina Precious Funkeyi, better known as Preshzino Songz 🌍 is a Singer and Songwriter from Nigeria 🇳🇬 who is redefining the genre with his signature Afro Seduction vibes. This unique sound blends the pulsating rhythms of Afrobeats with the smooth melodies of R&B and the soulful essence of Soul music, creating a spiritual experience that captivates listeners without needing permission to touch their souls. Self-proclaimed as the "King of Afro Seduction Vibes," Preshzino songz music is both a journey and a destination—a melodic fusion that resonates deeply with audiences worldwide.

Preshzino songz has collaborated with USA-based producers, further enriching his sound and expanding his global reach. As he continues to experiment and innovate, he is on a mission to take over the world, one seductive beat at a time. With his unmistakable talent and visionary approach, Preshzino Songz is not just an artist—he's a movement, poised to leave an indelible mark on the music industry.

bio:
Mozay Calloway (also known as Mosaic Calloway or Mozay), a musician, songwriter, and Web3 creator from Syracuse, NY (with ties to Brooklyn).
 
Music career: He describes himself as a "Writer of Themes and Anthems" and releases hip-hop/rap tracks. Recent projects include the 2025 album Dear Vikki (with tracks like "Amen," "Rain Dancer," "Luxury," "Say What Now") and singles like "Seat at the Table," "Bushido," and others. His music is available on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, SoundCloud, and more. He runs We The CEO LLC, empowering artists to own their brands and be CEOs" of their own names.

Web3/NFT involvement: Active in blockchain music, NFTs (e.g., $MOZAY Rune, Quakey Undefined project, GremGoyles), and community building. He hosts or participates in X Spaces (often with Web3 creators like discussing music, personal growth, healing, and crypto topics. He blends real-life discussions with music drops and events.
Online presence:
  
X/Twitter: @CeoMozay (around 900–1K followers, active in spaces and music promotion).

Other platforms: Spotify/Apple Music for music; NFT collections via LaunchMyNFT; YouTube channel for videos and open mics.

He’s known in indie hip-hop and Web3 circles for community-focused work, personal storytelling (e.g., themes of loss, growth, and resilience), and crossovers between traditional music and blockchain utility. He often collaborates on events, giveaways, and metaverse-adjacent projects.
